text: New: run_synthcheck_app() opens Shiny app generates synthetic respondents several language models benchmarks five tabs: Instrument, Personas, Models (API keys, temperature, attempts, progress bar time left), Compare (benchmark plain-language summary per model) Export. API keys stay memory session. Instrument Personas tabs offer CSV templates fill . New: sc_instrument(), sc_personas(), sc_persona_grid(), sc_model() sc_prompt() define synthetic respondents take , generate_synthetic() asks Anthropic, OpenAI local Ollama models (ellmer) answer, one respondent per call. New: write_synthetic() read_synthetic() save load generated data CSV, JSON, RDS Excel, as_synthetic_list() turns long table input authenticity_benchmark(). New: summarise_benchmark() describes model’s benchmark result plain sentences. New: behaviour_features() gives eight behaviour features per respondent (variability, extreme midpoint answers, acquiescence, key inconsistency, even-odd consistency, Mahalanobis distance person fit lz), synthetic_behaviour() turns Behaviour index, gg_behaviour() draws behaviour strip. New: authenticity_benchmark() builds synthetic authenticity benchmark: Overlap, Structure Behaviour every model, anchored shuffled real columns (0) second sample real people (100), weakest column default score. gg_benchmark() draws scale red (-100 less) pale (0) blue (100), values shuffled baseline stay readable. New: flag_careless() flags careless real respondents, clean_real = TRUE compares remaining ones. Data: hexaco_llm now holds six models (89,597 synthetic respondents).
